description: Fig. 7 is a single-panel vertical bar chart comparing the microhardness of an inverse-designed Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si steel composition obtained through four intelligent optimization algorithms. The ordinate is labelled "Microhardness (HV)", ticked from 0 to 800 in steps of 100; the abscissa is labelled "The optimization algorithm" with four categories printed as FA, PSO, SA and GWO. Four solid pastel bars are drawn: orange for FA, green for PSO, purple for SA and pale yellow for GWO. Each bar carries a printed numeric value above its top instead of an error bar: 733.59 HV (FA), 730.04 HV (PSO), 700.37 HV (SA) and 708.60 HV (GWO). All four bars terminate between the 700 and 800 gridlines, so the ranking is FA > PSO > GWO > SA, with FA highest and SA lowest; FA exceeds the runner-up PSO by only a small margin, and the total spread across the four algorithms is roughly 33 HV. No legend, no error bars and no scale bar are present. The figure demonstrates that the FA-optimized composition gives the maximum designed microhardness among the four optimization routes.

observations.observation: The y-axis is labelled 'Microhardness (HV)' and is ticked from 0 to 800 in increments of 100.
The x-axis is labelled 'The optimization algorithm' and carries four categories printed as FA, PSO, SA and GWO.
The FA bar (orange) is labelled with the value 733.59 HV, the highest printed value in the chart.
The PSO bar (green) is labelled 730.04 HV.
The SA bar (purple) is labelled 700.37 HV, the lowest printed value in the chart.
The GWO bar (yellow) is labelled 708.60 HV.
All four bars end between the 700 and 800 HV gridlines, giving the visual ranking FA > PSO > GWO > SA.
The chart contains no legend, no error bars and no scale bar.
The caption states that Fig. 7 shows the microhardness of the inverse designed material through different algorithms.
The citing text states the maximum microhardness calculated through the FA, PSO, SA and GWO algorithms was 733.59 HV, 730.04 HV, 700.37 HV and 708.60 HV, respectively.
The citing text states the alloy microhardness designed using FA presented the highest value, followed by PSO, GWO and SA, matching the printed bar order.
The citing text names the four optimization techniques as simulated annealing (SA), firefly optimization algorithm (FA), particle swarm optimization (PSO) and grey wolf optimization algorithm (GWO).

subfigures.description: Vertical bar chart of Microhardness (HV) on the y-axis (0-800, step 100) versus 'The optimization algorithm' on the x-axis, with four bars labelled FA (orange), PSO (green), SA (purple) and GWO (yellow); printed values 733.59, 730.04, 700.37 and 708.60 HV respectively appear above the bars.
